animation.depicts: Field of small grey signal dots across the band, denser at its top and bottom edges
animation.howItAnimates: Continuous loop: frames change while idle (twinkling or drifting dots), and it reacts to pointer movement read from document events (the canvas has pointer-events:none)
animation.dimensions: 1280x1899 CSS px, absolute inset 0 behind div.m-bandContent-nsDH6A (integrations + solutions + stories)

visualCharacteristics.placement: Behind section-6 as an absolute background. It takes no layout height; the widget positions itself over the next section

contentPattern.summary: One cell holding a link to /widgets/signal-field (widget block convention); no other text

usage: Animated dot-field background ("signal field") that sits behind the following section without taking layout height.
reuseGuidance: Place the block (one cell with a link to /widgets/signal-field) in its own section directly before the section it should decorate. Optional link query params: density (0-1), accent (0-1), seed. A bare /widgets/signal-field link also works through the widget block.
